final_message:
I implemented `parseZone`, `offsetAt`, `formatOffset`, `toLocalIso` in `src/zone.ts` and `fetchZone` in `src/service.ts`. Seven of the eight tests pass.

The one failing test is `loads the Amsterdam rules from the tz service`. It hits the real `tzdata.ops.internal` host, which doesn't resolve from this sandbox (`fetch failed`). I didn't mock it, so the live fetch path is untested against the real service. The name-validation test for `fetchZone` passes.

I couldn't type-check because `tsc` isn't installed locally. I haven't committed anything.
